notes: Steps: open https://reporting.edu.wyo.gov/ibi_apps/run.bip?BIP_REQUEST_TYPE=BIP_RUN&BIP_folder=IBFS%253A%252FWFC%252FRepository%252FPublic%252FAssessment%252FDisaggregated%252F&BIP_item=AssessPerformDistrictHTML.htm (page link on the WDE assessment reports page: Grades 3-10 WY-TOPP/WY-ALT Performance Results > Disaggregated > District Level); the WebFOCUS parameter form takes 15-25 seconds to render. Subjects English Language Arts (ELA) only (click the subject, then click All to clear it); By Specific Grade 10 only (click 10, then click All to clear it); Subgroup All Students, Race / Ethnicity: Black, Race / Ethnicity: Hispanic, Race / Ethnicity: White (click each, then click All to clear it); The report is built on request, has no fixed file URL, and the CSV downloads 2-5 minutes later as AssessmentPerformanceResultsDistrictNew_<UTC timestamp>.csv, renamed here. Changing School Year or Subjects queues a reset of the Grade and Subgroup lists which is applied when RUN REPORT is pressed, even though the boxes still show the old ticks, so Grade and Subgroup must be re-selected after every School Year or Subjects change or the report runs for all grades and all subgroups.
